Formula Spatial error model y = Xb + u, u = lambda W u + e (spreg ML_Error, exact log-determinant replaced by a truncated trace series). With Z = [1, X - mean, y - mean], G0 = Z'Z, G1 + G1' = Z'WZ + (Z'WZ)', G2 = (WZ)'(WZ) the Gram matrix of the filtered columns is A(lambda) = G0 - lambda (G1 + G1') + lambda^2 G2; one unit-scaled Cholesky solve per lambda gives beta and EE(lambda) = yy - 2 beta'r + beta'A beta. l(lambda) = -(n/2) ln(EE/n) + ln|I - lambda W|; lambda = global maximum on [-B, B] (1025-point derivative scan, 32 bisection steps). sigma2 = EE/n; Var(b) = sigma2 (Xs'Xs)^-1 treats lambda as known.

\begin{aligned}
\term{objective}{\ell(\lambda)}&=-\frac n2\ln\frac{\term{errorSumOfSquares}{\mathrm{EE}(\lambda)}}{n}+\term{logDeterminant}{\ln|I-\lambda W|}\\
\mathrm{EE}(\lambda)&=y_s^\top y_s-2\hat\beta^\top r+\hat\beta^\top A\hat\beta,
&A(\lambda)&=G_0-\lambda(G_1+G_1^\top)+\lambda^2G_2\\
\term{lambda}{\hat\lambda}&=\arg\max_{|\lambda|\le B}\ \ell(\lambda)
\end{aligned}
